# 1. Handle an empty tag list gracefully
    if not value:
        return []
        
    formatted_table_data = []
    
    # Convert the 'value' wrapper to a clean python list of paths
    tag_paths = list(value)
    
    # system.tag.readBlocking reads all tag values at once for maximum efficiency
    qualified_values = system.tag.readBlocking(tag_paths)
    
    # 2. Loop through each path and pair it with its live data
    for i in range(len(tag_paths)):
        path = tag_paths[i]
        
        # Extract the friendly name (everything after the last '/')
        name = path.split("/")[-1]
        
        # Get the live value from our read results
        live_value = qualified_values[i].value
        
        # Clean up floating decimals if necessary
        if isinstance(live_value, float):
            live_value = round(live_value, 2)
            
        # Append the fully structured object with all 3 columns
        formatted_table_data.append({
            "Name": name,
            "Value": live_value,
            "Tag Path": path
        })
        
    # 3. Return the fully structured array of objects to the table data property
    return formatted_table_data
